limitations: Historical synthetic/model calibration only; no new scientific adjudication or nature-level inference.

legacy.claim: An independent exhaustive great-circle candidate oracle (astropy SkyCoord.search_around_sky), run on every synthetic realization in this protocol, reproduces Astrolabe's cKDTree-based candidate/pair set exactly, confirming the ORB-11217 completeness fix continues to hold on the nonuniform, RA-wrap, and polar footprints used here.
legacy.kill: Any realization where the independent oracle's candidate or final pair set disagrees with Astrolabe's, on any footprint (equatorial, wrap, or polar) — this reopens a candidate-completeness question against Astrolabe directly and is not folded into this protocol's own bias-statistic verdict.
